ons.text: Aphetto is a city where Nivea abandoned the remnants of her order, traveled and met Ixidor, and it is the setting of the pits in the Onslaught story. A guard at Aphetto gives Chester a mortal wound as payment when Zagorka cannot afford the entrance fee, and Kamahl later resuscitates him, with Krosa's mutating power making him far larger and stronger.

Phage kills Nivea in the pits, and Ixidor, bankrupted by the loss, is left naked in the desert swearing revenge after the Cabal discover his forged coins and strip him. Kamahl fights Phage in the pits but his sister does not recognize him, so he stops the match and returns to Krosa to build an army.
The First commands the construction of the Grand Coliseum and Phage oversees the works, since Phage became both executioner and savior, helping others to the same rebirth she had found.
